description: This file defines the HTMLPurifier_Token_Comment class, which represents comment tokens in an HTML purifier library. It extends from the base HTMLPurifier_Token class and includes properties for comment data and whitespace status, as well as methods for construction and conversion to a node.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Token_Comment
classes.description: A class representing HTML comment tokens within the HTMLPurifier framework, generally used to handle HTML comments during sanitization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new comment token with provided comment data, line, and column information.

methods.name: toNode
methods.description: Converts this token into an HTMLPurifier_Node_Comment object.
